<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242);
renderer.setClearColor(0xc6b7a2);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const V=(x=0,y=0,z=0)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const angle=.337, cs=Math.cos(angle), sn=Math.sin(angle);
const view=V(0,sn,cs);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,121,-121,1,1800);
ref.position.copy(V(0,110,0)).addScaledVector(view,800);
ref.lookAt(0,110,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();
const point=(x,y,z)=>V(x-120,110+(121-y+z*sn)/cs,z);
const shift=(x,y,z=0)=>V(x,(-y+z*sn)/cs,z);
const mix=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const clamp=THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const smooth=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name; parent.add(g); return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.88){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness});
}
function mesh(parent,name,geometry,mat){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,mat);
  m.name=name;m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(m);return m;
}
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28);
function ell(parent,name,p,size,mat){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,sphere,mat);
  m.position.copy(p);m.scale.set(...size);return m;
}
function box(parent,name,p,size,mat){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size),mat);
  m.position.copy(p);return m;
}
function between(parent,name,a,b,r1,r2,mat){
  const d=b.clone().sub(a);
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,d.length(),18),mat);
  m.position.copy(a).lerp(b,.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),d.normalize());return m;
}
function grid(nu,nv,sample,reverse=false){
  const pos=[],uv=[],col=[],idx=[],norm=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++)for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){
    const s=sample(i/nu,j/nv);
    pos.push(...s.p.toArray());uv.push(i/nu,j/nv);
    if(s.c)col.push(s.c.r,s.c.g,s.c.b);
    if(s.n)norm.push(...s.n.toArray());
    if(i<nu&&j<nv){
      const a=j*(nu+1)+i,b=a+1,d=a+nu+1,e=d+1;
      if(reverse)idx.push(a,d,b,b,d,e);
      else idx.push(a,b,d,b,e,d);
    }
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  if(col.length)g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  if(norm.length)g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(norm,3));
  else g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
let seed=843895;
function random(){
  seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;
}
function texture(wood=false){
  const n=64,data=new Uint8Array(n*n*4);
  const line=Array.from({length:n},random);
  for(let y=0;y<n;y++)for(let x=0;x<n;x++){
    const w=Math.floor(y+1.6*Math.sin(x/n*Math.PI*2+y*.14)+n)%n;
    const k=wood?.84+.13*line[w]+.03*random():.846+.154*random();
    const i=(y*n+x)*4;
    data[i]=255*k;data[i+1]=(wood?250:255)*k;data[i+2]=(wood?237:255)*k;data[i+3]=255;
  }
  const t=new THREE.DataTexture(data,n,n);
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
  t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;t.generateMipmaps=true;
  t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;t.repeat.set(wood?1.5:4,wood?1.6:3);
  t.needsUpdate=true;return t;
}
const nap=texture(),woodGrain=texture(true);
function fabric(color,vertexColors=false){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,vertexColors,map:nap,bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.17,roughness:1,side:THREE.DoubleSide
  });
}
const gold=fabric(0xffb522),fingerMat=fabric(0x685640),coat=fabric(0xffffff,true);
const goldColor=new THREE.Color(0xffb922),creamColor=new THREE.Color(0xffe6be);
const darkMouth=material(0x332217),softMouth=material(0x88541b);
darkMouth.side=softMouth.side=THREE.DoubleSide;
const sclera=material(0x9f9179,.85),iris=material(0x433c32,.78);
const pupil=material(0x191716,.65),glint=material(0x9e9580,.6);

function cubic(a,b,c,d,t){
  return b+.5*t*(c-a+t*(2*a-5*b+4*c-d+t*(3*b-a-3*c+d)));
}
function sampleRows(rows,v){
  const f=clamp(v,0,1)*(rows.length-1),i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(f)),t=f-i;
  const a=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=rows[i],c=rows[i+1],d=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  return b.map((value,k)=>cubic(a[k],value,c[k],d[k],t));
}

// Each row describes a horizontal section of the stuffed body.
const leftRest=[
 [66,53,-33,.13,.13],[66,55,-33,11,10],[64,60,-33,21,17],
 [62,69,-32,28,22],[60,82,-31,33.4,25.5],[57,97,-31,38.5,28],
 [54,113,-33,42,31],[51,134,-34,46,33],[49,157,-36,51,35],
 [49,180,-36,53,36],[51,199,-36,48,32],[52,211,-37,33,25],[52,215,-37,.2,.2]
];
const leftUp=[
 [51.5,35.8,-38,.13,.13],[51.5,37.4,-38,10.6,9.5],[51,41.1,-37.8,20.2,16.3],
 [49.7,48.9,-37.1,27.7,21.8],[47.7,60,-36.4,33.8,25.4],[45.7,74.4,-35.2,38.6,28],
 [44.7,91.7,-35,41.8,30.8],[44.7,114.8,-35,45.4,32.9],[46.7,139.8,-36,50.4,35.5],
 [48.4,165.5,-36.5,53.2,36.8],[50.2,189.5,-36.5,50.6,34.4],[52,208.2,-37,35,26],[52,215,-37,.2,.2]
];
const rightRest=[
 [149,43,-51,.12,.12],[150,45,-51,11,9.5],[151,50,-51,20,15.5],
 [151.5,59,-51,26.3,20],[153,72,-50,31.5,24.5],[156.6,84,-50,34.8,26],
 [159.6,96,-49,36.8,28],[166,111,-48,40.7,31],[173.7,130,-47,45.2,33],
 [180,149,-46,47.6,35],[186,169,-45,49.2,37],[190,188,-45,50,36],
 [191,201,-45,44,32],[190,211,-45,28,24],[190,215,-45,.12,.12]
];
const rightLean=rightRest.map(row=>{
  const r=[...row],w=1-smooth(row[1],87,203);
  r[0]-=7.5*w;r[2]-=1.2*w;return r;
});
const rightLift=rightRest.map(row=>{
  const r=[...row];r[1]-=3.3*(1-smooth(row[1],90,194));return r;
});
function rowPoint(row,a){
  const p=point(row[0],row[1],row[2]);
  p.x+=Math.sin(a)*Math.max(.035,row[3]);p.z+=Math.cos(a)*Math.max(.035,row[4]);
  return p;
}
function bodySample(rows,t,a){
  const r=sampleRows(rows,t),p=rowPoint(r,a);
  const da=V(Math.max(.035,r[3])*Math.cos(a),0,-Math.max(.035,r[4])*Math.sin(a));
  const dt=rowPoint(sampleRows(rows,Math.min(1,t+.0003)),a)
    .sub(rowPoint(sampleRows(rows,Math.max(0,t-.0003)),a));
  return {p,n:dt.cross(da).normalize()};
}
const fibreMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({side:THREE.DoubleSide,vertexColors:true,roughness:1});
function bodyFibres(parent,skin,count){
  const geo=skin.geometry,p0=geo.attributes.position,n0=geo.attributes.normal,c0=geo.attributes.color;
  const morphs=geo.morphAttributes.position;
  const pos=[],cols=[],delta=morphs.map(()=>[]);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const id=Math.floor(random()*p0.count);
    const p=V().fromBufferAttribute(p0,id),n=V().fromBufferAttribute(n0,id);
    const t=V(random()-.5,random()-.64,random()-.5);
    t.addScaledVector(n,-t.dot(n)).normalize();
    const w=V().crossVectors(n,t).multiplyScalar(.09+.095*random());
    const tip=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,.22+random()*.5).addScaledVector(t,.27);
    p.addScaledVector(n,-.09);
    pos.push(p.x+w.x,p.y+w.y,p.z+w.z,p.x-w.x,p.y-w.y,p.z-w.z,...tip.toArray());
    const c=new THREE.Color().fromBufferAttribute(c0,id).multiplyScalar(.82+random()*.29);
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++)cols.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
    morphs.forEach((m,k)=>{
      const x=m.getX(id),y=m.getY(id),z=m.getZ(id);
      for(let j=0;j<3;j++)delta[k].push(x,y,z);
    });
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cols,3));g.computeVertexNormals();
  g.morphTargetsRelative=true;
  g.morphAttributes.position=delta.map(a=>new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(a,3));
  const f=mesh(parent,'short surface fibres',g,fibreMat);f.castShadow=false;
  return f;
}
function body(owner,head,rest,poses,split,patchTop,patchAngle){
  const parts=[];
  for(const [parent,name,lo,hi] of [[head,'crown and cheeks',0,split],[owner,'chest and belly',split,1]]){
    const delta=poses.map(()=>[]),dn=poses.map(()=>[]);
    const geom=grid(92,46,(u,v)=>{
      const a=(u-.5)*Math.PI*2,t=mix(lo,hi,v),s=bodySample(rest,t,a);
      const y=sampleRows(rest,t)[1];
      const phi=Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-patchAngle),Math.cos(a-patchAngle));
      const patch=1-(phi/1.29)**2-((y-patchTop-53)/53)**2;
      s.c=goldColor.clone().lerp(creamColor,smooth(patch,-.042,.045));
      poses.forEach((rows,k)=>{
        const target=bodySample(rows,t,a);
        delta[k].push(...target.p.sub(s.p).toArray());dn[k].push(...target.n.sub(s.n).toArray());
      });
      return s;
    },true);
    geom.morphTargetsRelative=true;
    geom.morphAttributes.position=delta.map(a=>new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(a,3));
    geom.morphAttributes.normal=dn.map(a=>new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(a,3));
    const skin=mesh(parent,name,geom,coat);
    parts.push(skin,bodyFibres(parent,skin,5500));
  }
  let rows=rest;
  return {
    pose(...weights){
      for(const m of parts)weights.forEach((w,k)=>m.morphTargetInfluences[k]=w);
      rows=rest.map((r,i)=>r.map((v,j)=>weights.reduce((s,w,k)=>s+w*(poses[k][i][j]-v),v)));
    },
    // Find the front of the loft along the reference camera's viewing ray.
    face(x,y,raise=0){
      const at=t=>{
        const r=sampleRows(rows,t),a=Math.asin(clamp((x-r[0])/Math.max(.04,r[3]),-.99999,.99999));
        const p=rowPoint(r,a);
        return {p,y:r[1]+Math.max(.035,r[4])*Math.cos(a)*sn};
      };
      let lo=0,hi=.72;
      for(let k=0;k<16;k++){
        const mid=(lo+hi)/2;
        if(at(mid).y<y)lo=mid;else hi=mid;
      }
      return at((lo+hi)*.5).p.addScaledVector(view,raise);
    }
  };
}
const left=group(scene,'character-left-writing'),lh=group(left,'head');
const right=group(scene,'character-right-leaning'),rh=group(right,'head');
const writer=body(left,lh,leftRest,[leftUp],5/12,130,.23);
const helper=body(right,rh,rightRest,[rightLean,rightLift],6/14,150,.30);

function eye(head,name,r,gaze){
  const g=group(head,name);
  ell(g,'soft eye surround',V(0,0,-.5),[r*1.03,r*1.04,r*.70],sclera);
  const lens=group(g,'gaze');
  ell(lens,'iris',V(gaze*r,-r*.105,r*.38),[r*.745,r*.805,r*.51],iris);
  ell(lens,'pupil',V(gaze*r*1.25,-r*.15,r*.64),[r*.586,r*.635,r*.37],pupil);
  ell(lens,'reflected light',V(gaze*r-.19*r,.19*r,r*.93),[r*.085,r*.068,r*.05],glint);
  return (skin,x,y,nx,ny,nz,depth=.35,look=0)=>{
    g.position.copy(skin.face(x,y,depth));
    g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,0,1),V(nx,ny,nz).normalize());
    lens.rotation.y=look;
  };
}
const le=eye(lh,'eye near',8.75,.12),lf=eye(lh,'eye far',7.4,.03);
const re=eye(rh,'eye near',8.6,-.19),rf=eye(rh,'eye far',5.65,-.16);

function mouth(head,skin,isHelper){
  const g=group(head,'mouth');
  const nu=32,nv=3;
  const geo=grid(nu,nv,()=>({p:V()}));
  mesh(g,'curved mouth opening',geo,isHelper?darkMouth:softMouth);
  const a=geo.attributes.position;
  return (x,y,width,slope,smile,open,turn)=>{
    for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){
      const u=i/nu,s=Math.sin(Math.PI*u),px=x+width*u;
      const py=y+slope*u+smile*s,h=Math.pow(Math.max(.0001,s),.73)*open;
      const top=skin.face(px,py,.54),bottom=skin.face(px,py+h,.54);
      for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++){
        const v=j/nv,p=top.clone().lerp(bottom,v).addScaledVector(view,.16*Math.sin(v*Math.PI));
        a.setXYZ(j*(nu+1)+i,p.x,p.y,p.z);
      }
    }
    if(!isHelper)softMouth.color.set(0x88541b).lerp(darkMouth.color,turn);
    a.needsUpdate=true;geo.computeVertexNormals();geo.computeBoundingSphere();geo.computeBoundingBox();
  };
}
const lm=mouth(lh,writer,false),rm=mouth(rh,helper,true);

// Tube rings follow the posed centreline, keeping the arms joined at the shoulders and wrists.
function sweep(parent,name,rows,mat,dynamic=false){
  const nu=24,nv=Math.max(24,(rows.length-1)*7);
  const geo=grid(nu,nv,()=>({p:V()}));
  const obj=mesh(parent,name,geo,mat);
  const circle=Array.from({length:nu+1},(_,i)=>[Math.cos(i*2*Math.PI/nu),Math.sin(i*2*Math.PI/nu)]);
  function pose(offset){
    const coords=rows.map((r,i)=>{
      const v=offset?offset(i/(rows.length-1),i):[0,0,0];
      return point(r[0]+v[0],r[1]+v[1],r[2]+v[2]);
    });
    const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords,false,'catmullrom',.4);
    const frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(nv,false);
    const pAttr=geo.attributes.position;
    for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++){
      const f=j/nv,u=curve.getUtoTmapping(f),p=curve.getPoint(u),r=sampleRows(rows,u);
      const n=frames.normals[j],b=frames.binormals[j];
      for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){
        const c=circle[i][0]*Math.max(.06,r[3]),s=circle[i][1]*Math.max(.06,r[4]??r[3]);
        pAttr.setXYZ(j*(nu+1)+i,p.x+n.x*c+b.x*s,p.y+n.y*c+b.y*s,p.z+n.z*c+b.z*s);
      }
    }
    pAttr.needsUpdate=true;geo.computeVertexNormals();
    const na=geo.attributes.normal;
    for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++){
      const a=j*(nu+1),b=a+nu,n=V().fromBufferAttribute(na,a).add(V().fromBufferAttribute(na,b)).normalize();
      na.setXYZ(a,n.x,n.y,n.z);na.setXYZ(b,n.x,n.y,n.z);
    }
    na.needsUpdate=true;geo.computeBoundingSphere();geo.computeBoundingBox();
  }
  pose(null);return dynamic?pose:obj;
}
const la=group(left,'arm holding pencil');
const poseWritingArm=sweep(la,'bent golden arm',[
 [22,113,-36,5],[17,121,-29,12.4],[9.5,143,-18,14.3],[4.5,168,-4,14.8],

sweep(lhnd,'middle finger',[[28,201,25,4],[32,205,30,4],[38.6,209.2,32,3.6],[44.2,211.5,32,2],[45.2,211.7,32,.15]],fingerMat);

const furniture=group(scene,'classroom'),tableY=31;
function onPlane(x,y,h=tableY){return V(x-120,h,(y-121+(h-110)*cs)/sn);}
const wood=material(0xd59a54),edgeWood=material(0x9a5b2e),lacquer=material(0xc28a48);
wood.map=edgeWood.map=lacquer.map=woodGrain;
function quad(parent,name,corners,mat){
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(corners.flatMap(p=>p.toArray()),3));
  g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([0,0,1,0,1,1,0,1],2));
  g.setIndex([0,2,1,0,3,2]);g.computeVertexNormals();
  mat.side=THREE.DoubleSide;return mesh(parent,name,g,mat);
}
function desktop(name,xy,h){
  const g=group(furniture,name),top=xy.map(p=>onPlane(...p,h));
  quad(g,'wooden writing surface',top,wood);
  top.forEach((a,i)=>{
    const b=top[(i+1)%4];
    quad(g,'apron edge',[a,b,b.clone().add(V(0,-4.7,0)),a.clone().add(V(0,-4.7,0))],edgeWood);
    box(g,'desk leg',a.clone().add(V(0,-43,0)),[5,82,5],edgeWood);
  });
}

const paper=material(0xffefce),paper2=material(0xfff5df),pageEdge=material(0xdabd91);
const cover=material(0x6c4b33),lineMat=material(0xc5b392),binding=material(0x9c7e57);
function book(name,bx,by,dx,dy,leftWidth,rightWidth,sideY,h){
  const g=group(furniture,name),base=onPlane(bx,by,h);
  const forward=onPlane(bx+dx,by+dy,h).sub(base);
  function pagePos(side,u,v,height){
    const p=base.clone().addScaledVector(forward,v);
    p.x+=side*(side<0?leftWidth:rightWidth)*u;
    p.z+=side*sideY*u/sn;p.y+=height;return p;
  }
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const arch=(u,v)=>1.3+3.6*Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.pow(u,.73))*(1-.23*v)+.6*u+1.15*v*Math.sin(Math.PI*u);
    mesh(g,'cloth cover',grid(16,2,(u,v)=>({p:pagePos(side,1.018*u,v*1.015,-.1)}),side>0),cover);
    for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
      const f=k/5;
      mesh(g,'layer of paper',grid(26,2,(u,v)=>({p:pagePos(side,u*(1.008-.008*f),v+.008*(1-f),.12+f*arch(u,v))}),side>0),k%2?paper:pageEdge);
    }
    mesh(g,'open cream page',grid(42,12,(u,v)=>({p:pagePos(side,u,v,arch(u,v))}),side>0),side<0?paper:paper2);
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const u=.76+.048*i;
      between(g,'faint paper mark',pagePos(side,u,.90,arch(u,.9)+.07),pagePos(side,u+.09,.90,arch(u+.09,.9)+.07),.08,.055,lineMat);
    }
  }
  between(g,'centre fold',pagePos(1,0,0,1.32),pagePos(1,0,1,1.32),.22,.29,binding);
}

// Cyclic cubic interpolation with time-weighted tangents and a 100 ms return interval.
const times=[0,200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400];
function track(values){
  const n=values.length,dt=times.map((t,i)=>(i+1<n?times[i+1]:1500)-t);
  const slope=values.map((v,i)=>(values[(i+1)%n]-v)/dt[i]);
  const tangent=slope.map((b,i)=>{
    const j=(i+n-1)%n,a=slope[j];
    if(a*b<=0)return 0;
    const l=2*dt[i]+dt[j],r=dt[i]+2*dt[j];
    return (l+r)/(l/a+r/b);
  });
  return (i,u)=>{
    const j=(i+1)%n,u2=u*u,u3=u2*u;
    return (2*u3-3*u2+1)*values[i]+(u3-2*u2+u)*dt[i]*tangent[i]
      +(-2*u3+3*u2)*values[j]+(u3-u2)*dt[i]*tangent[j];
  };
}
const motion=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({

  turn:[0,.01,.08,.66,.88,.98,1,1],
  lean:[0,.72,.88,.94,1,1,.99,1],

  nearX:[51.4,49.3,49.4,60.3,63.0,62.9,62.5,62.5],
  nearY:[88.7,85.1,82.6,72.3,67.2,63.5,61.6,61.8],

  farY:[91.6,87.4,84.8,69.4,62.6,58.5,56.5,56.6],
  mouthX:[63.6,55.0,55.5,67.8,70.8,69.5,69.6,69.6],
  mouthY:[109.8,103.6,100.3,91.8,84.8,80.6,79.7,79.8],
  nearRX:[148.3,141.2,140.3,140.8,140.5,140.5,140.6,140.7],
  nearRY:[72.5,75.3,74.9,73.5,71.7,69.3,68.3,68.0],
  helperMouthX:[121.7,113.3,112.8,113.8,114.5,114.2,114.4,114.7],
  helperMouthY:[86.3,90.2,89.5,88.6,86.7,84.5,83.0,83.4],
  strokeX:[0,-5.2,-12.0,-19.7,-22.1,-22.8,-23,-22.8],
  strokeY:[0,-2.0,-3.9,-9.1,-10.1,-9.6,-9.3,-9.5],
  pencilAngle:[0,.08,.12,.23,.31,.33,.34,.33],
  rubX:[0,-7.6,-18.1,-12.6,-15,-18.1,-12.1,-14.8],
  rubY:[0,-6.4,1.1,-5.7,-5.9,-2.5,-7.4,-5.7]
}).map(([k,v])=>[k,track(v)]));

const characters=[left,right];
function render(t){
  const time=((t%1500)+1500)%1500;
  const i=Math.min(7,Math.floor(time/200)),u=(time-times[i])/(i===7?100:200);
  const value=name=>motion[name](i,u);
  const rise=value('rise'),turn=value('turn'),lean=value('lean'),lift=value('lift');
  writer.pose(rise);helper.pose(lean,lift);

  le(writer,value('nearX'),value('nearY'),mix(-.22,.45,turn),mix(.09,.20,turn),.98,.35,.23*turn);
  lf(writer,value('farX'),value('farY'),mix(.56,.995,turn),.04,mix(.84,-.16,turn),.35-2.25*turn,.12*turn);
  lm(value('mouthX'),value('mouthY'),16+2.8*turn,mix(1.2,-.35,turn),mix(1.8,-.65,turn),1.55+2.9*turn,turn);

  re(helper,value('nearRX'),value('nearRY'),-.25-.09*lean,.14,.96,.35,-.04*lean);
  rf(helper,122.1-8.9*lean,69.9+2.8*lean-4.8*lift,-.89,.08,.44,.35);
  rm(value('helperMouthX'),value('helperMouthY'),22-3.4*lean,1.8-1.45*lean,1.0,3.2+.25*lean,0);

  const wx=value('strokeX'),wy=value('strokeY'),wz=rise*2.2;
  lhnd.position.copy(shift(wx,wy,wz));
  pencil.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(view,value('pencilAngle'));
  poseWritingArm(f=>{
    const w=smooth(f,.02,.84);
    return [mix(-7.7*rise,wx,w),mix(-18.5*rise,wy,w),mix(-2.4*rise,wz,w)];
  });
  lh2.position.copy(shift(-1.6*rise,-3.3*rise,-.3*rise));
  poseRestArm(f=>[mix(-8,-1.6,f)*rise,mix(-18,-3.3,f)*rise,mix(-2.3,-.3,f)*rise]);

  rh2.position.copy(shift(-12.4*rise,-10.8*rise,-2.6*rise));
  poseFarArm(f=>[mix(-7.1*lean,-12.4*rise,f),mix(-2.3*lift,-10.8*rise,f),mix(-lean,-2.6*rise,f)]);

  const dx=value('rubX'),dy=value('rubY'),dz=-dx*.18;
  rhnd.position.copy(shift(dx,dy,dz));
  poseReach(f=>{
    const w=smooth(f,.03,.94);
    return [mix(-4.9*lean,dx,w),mix(-1.9*lift,dy,w),mix(-.8*lean,dz,w)];
  });
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
